These are courses that I have taught in the past.

<div class="section-rule"><span class="lbl">La Trobe University</span><div class="line"></div></div>

::: {.plain-list}
-   **Scientific Computing** (Junior year) &mdash; 2010&ndash;2013 &mdash; This course focused on numerical methods. Topics included numerical root finding, optimization, integration, and numerical differential equation solving.
-   **Linear Algebra** (Freshman) &mdash; 2010 &mdash; Standard first year linear algebra course covering vectors, matrices, eigenvalues, and linear transformations.
:::

<div class="section-rule"><span class="lbl">California Institute of Technology</span><div class="line"></div></div>

::: {.plain-list}
-   **Galois Theory and Representation Theory** (Sophomore) &mdash; 2013&ndash;2016 &mdash; Field extensions, Galois groups, and representation theory.
-   **Combinatorial Analysis** (Graduate) &mdash; 2015&ndash;2016 &mdash; Graph theory and other related combinatorial problems.
-   **Quantum Calculus and q-Special Functions** (Graduate) &mdash; 2013 &mdash; The theory of discrete calculus and their associated discrete hypergeometric functions.
:::

<div class="section-rule"><span class="lbl">University of Maine, Orono</span><div class="line"></div></div>

::: {.plain-list}
-   **Calculus 1** (Freshman) &mdash; 2017 &mdash; Standard course on differentiation, integration, and differential equations.
-   **Algebra** (Graduate) &mdash; 2016 &mdash; Course on Linear Algebra with a focus on Lie Algebras.
-   **Differential Equations and Linear Algebra** (Sophomore) &mdash; 2017 &mdash; A course on linear differential equations and abstract linear algebra.
